text:
lia: quick heads-up — console spiked fncall schema rejects in prod-eu after strict canary flip. billing tokens jumped for a few customers.

lia: small log: [2026-03-25T09:03:12Z] validator WARN: expected object 'result' got array; req=r-pt9; key=acct_13; route=prod-eu -> routed_to=variant-x; fallback=degenerate

samir: confirmed ~4x validation.fail_count since strict=true.

maya: are these causing immediate fallbacks and double charges? @alex

alex: yes — current router treats hard validation rejects as a retry to degenerate variant and billing counts the fallback as a full invoke, so customers effectively see duplicate charges.

katie: console only shows "invocation errors" and "fallbacks" — no per-route validation error detail. ops can't triage type_mismatch vs missing_field.

jon: proposal: have validator emit small response headers on reject, e.g. `X-RW-Validate: strict` and `X-RW-Validate-Err: missing_field:result`. Router reads those and tags telemetry `route.fallback_reason` and `validation.fail_type` without reparsing payload. Minimal agent change.

samir: telemetry: sample 100% failures, 1% successes; add labels `validation.fail_type` and `routing.decision`.

maya: billing policy question: should malformed requests count toward fncall quota? SDK folks say yes; billing ops prefers not to penalize.

alex: short-term: mark them billable but show a separate "validation" charge line in console and open an appeals path. revisit after we have numbers.

katie: console changes: add `last_validation_error` column with redacted sample link and quick filter by `validation.fail_type`. also a dashboard showing top offending API keys.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 4810000000 - validation.fail_rate > 0.9% (5m) prod-eu. runbook: page eng-platform oncall.

jon: quick impl snippet:
```
if not validate(payload):
  resp.headers['X-RW-Validate']='strict'
  resp.headers['X-RW-Validate-Err']='expected_object_result:got_array'
  return 400
```

lia: action items: jon -> header+router tag PR (48h); samir -> telemetry + dashboard card (72h); alex -> billing ledger spec (EOW); katie -> UX wireframe (sync Tue). adding note to runbook.

lia: thanks — tracking in incident tracker :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack-style thread about fncall schema validation causing fallback routing and billing spike; includes log, header proposal, telemetry labels, console UX, runbook alert, and action items. Single continuous text string; no title field per agents.md.
